infrastructure_adjustment_required.issue: Team4A's canonical ingestion pipeline (app/pipeline/canonical_ingestion.py -> canonical_mutations.py's delete_exact_points) unconditionally attempts to delete any pre-existing chunks for a document before inserting new ones. When the educopilot_chunks collection does not exist AT ALL (the from-zero-rebuild case, never previously exercised), Qdrant's delete endpoint returns 404 'Collection does not exist' rather than a no-op, causing the whole ingestion request to fail with HTTP 500.
infrastructure_adjustment_required.fix_applied: Pre-created the empty educopilot_chunks collection (384-dim, Cosine, correct payload indexes) using Team4B's own existing, already-approved VectorStoreManager.ensure_collection() method (per docs/CONTRACT_DECISIONS.md's own statement that 'Team 4B owns/provisions the shared production collection'), constructed with qdrant_collection_name pointed at the canonical name. No application code was modified.
infrastructure_adjustment_required.scope: One-time, read/write-only operational step (collection creation via an existing sanctioned method), not a code change. Documented separately per this task's own instruction.
